title: Moose: Latent concept learning with reasoning-shortcut awareness in $\mathcal{EL}^{++}$
abstract: arXiv:2608.12961v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The OWL 2 EL profile is used in some of the largest production ontologies, including the Gene Ontology and SNOMED CT. Existing neuro-symbolic (NeSy) learning methods accept propositional theories or Datalog, and reasoning-shortcut (RS) awareness has not been investigated in ontology settings. We present Moose, a method that compiles an $\mathcal{EL}^{++}$ TBox and finite ABox to a Sentential Decision Diagram (SDD). The SDD acts as a differentiable weighted-model-counting layer, and we add closure clauses outside the $\mathcal{EL}^{++}$ profile on declared exhaustive families to overcome the limited expressivity of $\mathcal{EL}^{++}$ under partial supervision. We show termination, soundness, completeness, and polynomial intermediate sizes, and validate the proofs in Lean. We then define the first formal partial-supervision latent-concept-learning task over an OWL EL ontology, i.e., learning per-individual classifiers for latent concepts

translated_title: Moose：在$\mathcal{EL}^{++}$中具有推理捷径意识的潜在概念学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12961v1 公告类型：新  摘要：OWL 2 EL配置文件被用于一些最大的生产本体中，包括基因本体和SNOMED CT。现有的神经符号（NeSy）学习方法接受命题理论或Datalog，并且在本体设置中尚未研究推理捷径（RS）意识。我们提出了Moose，一种将$\mathcal{EL}^{++}$ TBox和有限ABox编译为命题决策图（SDD）的方法。SDD充当可微加权模型计数层，并且我们在声明的穷尽族上在$\mathcal{EL}^{++}$配置文件之外添加闭包子句，以克服在部分监督下$\mathcal{EL}^{++}$表达能力的局限性。我们证明了终止性、健全性、完备性和多项式中间大小，并在Lean中验证了证明。然后，我们定义了在OWL EL本体上的第一个正式的部分监督潜在概念学习任务，即为潜在概念学习每个个体的分类器。
tldr: 本文提出Moose方法，通过编译$\mathcal{EL}^{++}$本体到可微SDD并添加闭包子句，首次在OWL EL本体上实现具有推理捷径意识的潜在概念学习，并提供了形式化验证。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Moose, which compiles $\mathcal{EL}^{++}$ ontologies to differentiable SDDs with closure clauses, enabling the first formal partial-supervision latent-concept learning with reasoning-shortcut awareness in OWL EL, with formal proofs in Lean.
